---
description-meta: "Revenue at stake for a payment-step fix and for mobile-only fixes, with the A/B test sizes behind each."
title: "Revenue at stake"
pagetitle: "Revenue at stake"
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {
  loadResults,
  dataAlert,
  revenueChart,
  dataTable,
  formatPercent,
  formatUsd,
  formatCount,
  STEP_LABELS,
} from "./charts.js"

results = loadResults({
  mobileOnly: FileAttachment("sources/results/sizing_mobile_only.csv"),
  paymentTests: FileAttachment("sources/results/sizing_payment_step.csv"),
  couponHoldout: FileAttachment("sources/results/sizing_coupon_holdout.csv"),
})
```

```{ojs}
//| classes: data-alert-slot
dataAlert(results.missing)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mobileOnly = results.data.mobileOnly
paymentTests = results.data.paymentTests
eightWeeks = paymentTests.find((row) => row.test_weeks === 8)
eight = eightWeeks ?? {}
mobileBest = Math.max(...mobileOnly.map((row) => row.extra_revenue_usd))
timesBest = Math.round(eight.revenue_at_detectable_lift_usd / mobileBest)
dailySessions = Math.round(eight.sessions_entering_in_sample / 92)
holdout = results.data.couponHoldout[0] ?? {}
holdoutPoints = holdout.holdout_detectable_difference_points?.toFixed(1) ?? "—"
```

::: {.lede}
A payment-step win that an 8-week test can detect is worth
${formatUsd(eight.revenue_at_detectable_lift_usd)} per 92 days, about ${formatCount(timesBest)}
times the best case for any mobile-only fix.
:::

```{ojs}
//| classes: slot-revenue
revenueChart(Plot, { mobileOnly, paymentTest: eightWeeks }, {
  width,
  title: `The payment-step test's smallest detectable win, ${formatUsd(eight.revenue_at_detectable_lift_usd)}, dwarfs every mobile-only case`,
  subtitle: "Extra revenue per 92 days in the sample's US dollars. Mobile-only cases assume the mobile deficit is as large as its 95% interval allows and a fix closes half of it.",
})
```

## Payment step, all devices

Each extra percentage point of shipping-to-payment conversion is worth
${formatUsd(eight.revenue_per_point_usd)} per 92 days. This assumes sessions that newly reach
payment buy at today's rate and order value for their device, and that test traffic matches the
sample's daily average of ${formatCount(dailySessions)} sessions entering the step.

```{ojs}
//| classes: slot-table
dataTable({
  caption: "What a 50/50 test of the payment step can detect",
  rows: paymentTests,
  highlight: (row) => row.test_weeks === 8,
  columns: [
    { label: "Test length", value: (row) => `${row.test_weeks} weeks` },
    { label: "Sessions per arm", value: (row) => formatCount(row.sessions_per_arm), numeric: true },
    { label: "Baseline", value: (row) => formatPercent(row.baseline_conversion), numeric: true },
    {
      label: "Smallest detectable lift",
      value: (row) => `${row.detectable_lift_points.toFixed(1)} points`,
      numeric: true,
    },
    {
      label: "Worth per 92 days",
      value: (row) => formatUsd(row.revenue_at_detectable_lift_usd),
      numeric: true,
    },
  ],
})
```

## Mobile-only fixes, best case

```{ojs}
//| classes: slot-table
dataTable({
  caption: "Half of the largest mobile shortfall each interval allows",
  rows: mobileOnly,
  columns: [
    { label: "Step", value: (row) => STEP_LABELS.get(row.step_name) },
    {
      label: "Largest shortfall",
      value: (row) => `${(row.worst_mobile_deficit * 100).toFixed(2)} points`,
      numeric: true,
    },
    {
      label: "Mobile sessions",
      value: (row) => formatCount(row.mobile_sessions_entered),
      numeric: true,
    },
    {
      label: "Buy after step",
      value: (row) => formatPercent(row.purchase_rate_after_step),
      numeric: true,
    },
    { label: "Extra revenue", value: (row) => formatUsd(row.extra_revenue_usd), numeric: true },
  ],
})
```

## Coupon holdout

Confirming the observed coupon difference would need
${formatCount(holdout.buyers_per_arm_for_observed_difference)} first-time buyers per arm, about
${formatCount(Math.round(holdout.days_of_first_time_buyers_needed))} days of buyers. A
${formatCount(holdout.holdout_days)}-day holdout detects only differences of
${holdoutPoints} points or
more, so it can guard against a large loss of repeat buyers but cannot settle a small one.
